name: ECHO Re:Kill
source:
You wake up in an unfamiliar “preparation area,” surrounded by strangers.

At that moment, the system’s voice rings in your ears—“New mission, commencing immediately.”

Mission after mission, life and death hang in the balance. Some return safely, while others remain lost at the end of the line.

Only by accumulating points can you reclaim your freedom.

This is an adventure with no retreat. All you can do is keep moving forward.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3861190/]Steam[/url]]
